A quick bit of reassurance on quality:

Our roses are premium own-root plants (not grafted), grown in 1-gallon containers with soil and defoliated before shipping so they travel safely.
We stand behind them with a one-year guarantee on roses, 90 days on perennials, and a failure-to-bloom guarantee on bulbs.
